text:
maria: Quick design check — putting this here before tomorrow's sync. New idea: show a horizontal "suppression timeline" in the alert preview that visualizes active suppression windows across channels. Also grouping channels into buckets (eg. pager, email, slack) so the preview is less noisy. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.internal/ux/suppress-timeline.png :eyes:

anil: Love the timeline idea. a11y note: if it's a horizontal timeline we need a logical reading order for screen readers (start -> end) and visible focus for keyboard navigation. Also consider an aria-label on each window segment. :a11y:

lisa: Microcopy suggestion — replace "suppression" in the preview header with "quiet periods" for user-facing flows. "Suppression" is a bit technical and confuses PMs. 

maria: @lisa good call. We still call it suppression in the backend — but UX can surface "Quiet periods" and show a tooltip: "Quiet periods temporarily mute notifications for selected channels."

devin: Implementation concerns: if we render per-channel segments and group them, we'll need to coalesce overlapping windows to keep perf ok. Rough idea in pseudo: ```js
// merge windows by group
function mergeWindows(windows){/* sort by start, merge overlaps */}
```

jake: Keyboard flow: when timeline gets focus, press left/right to move between windows, enter to edit. Suggest `role="list"` for the timeline and `role="listitem"` per segment so SRs announce positions. Also tabindex=0 on the first item only.

maria: UI question — when channels are grouped, do we show a brief inline list on hover or an explicit "view channels" pill? Hover is nice on desktop but we need a persistent affordance for mobile.

tara: For mobile we should always show a compact pill with count ("3 channels") and expand to a drawer when tapped. Avoid hover-only interactions. Also add copy: "3 channels are quiet during this window."

anil: Also recommend a contrast check for the timeline colors and a high-contrast toggle. Right now faint pastel segments fail AA for 2px separators.

lisa: UX nit: when a suppression is system-generated (auto-snooze), add an icon and tooltip that says "auto-snooze — triggered by X". Users keep asking why things muted themselves.

devin: Backend/data note: we already expose `suppressions[].source` in the API so UI can badge them. But grouping requires an extra call if we load channel metadata lazily. I can add a groupedChannels field to the preview payload if folks want it.

maria: Action items: 1) design: iterate mobile pill + expanded drawer (maria) 2) a11y checklist: reading order, roles, contrast (anil) 3) copy swap to "Quiet periods" + tooltip (lisa) 4) eng: consider merged windows endpoint (devin) 5) keyboard pattern doc (jake). I'll drop mocks before EOD. :thumbsup:

design-bot: New mock uploaded: https://img.redwood.internal/ux/suppress-timeline-v2.png (uploaded by maria)

jake: Quick accessibility PS — when announcing the timeline, SR should say "Quiet periods timeline, N items, use left/right to navigate". We can pass `aria-live="polite"` updates on change.

maria: Thanks everyone — filing a short PRD and linking here in the thread. If anyone sees blockers before the sync, ping me.

tara: one more tiny thing — rename label "Mute channels" to "Quiet channels" across preview to match copy parity.

maria: noted. Closing the loop after mocks are posted. :)
